instance.description: Configured ServiceNow instance name. Optional; uses the current instance when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum log lines to return (default 100, max 1000).

pattern.description: Optional regular expression (at most 256 characters); only matching lines are returned. Invalid expressions and nested quantifiers such as (a+)+ are rejected.

result_id.description: sys_id of the ATF test result (sys_atf_test_result).
